interfaces.purpose: Generic AMM swap abstraction for strategies that buy/sell vault tokens on the open market.
surface: swap(address tokenIn,address tokenOut,uint256 amountIn,uint256 minAmountOut) external returns (uint256 amountOut)
interfaces.interactionContract: the strategy approves the adapter for amountIn then calls swap; minAmountOut is the strategy's slippage floor; amountOut is trusted as realized output
interfaces.notes: no access-control contract; CurveAMMAdapter leaves swap permissionless (safe: caller funds+receives own swap).

interfaces.purpose: Minimal Solidity mirror of the Curve Router NG Vyper exchange() at 0x16C6521Dff6baB339122a0FE25a9116693265353 (TRUSTED).
interfaces.interactionContract: _route interleaves [tokenIn,pool0,token1,...,tokenOut] padded to 11; _swap_params per-hop [i,j,swap_type,pool_type,n_coins]; _expected is the slippage floor; CurveAMMAdapter passes _receiver=msg.sender (the strategy).
interfaces.notes: payable but called without ETH for ERC20 routes; trusted to honor _expected and report true output

interfaces.status: CHANGED (story-045/046 since run-12 baseline; story-047 in this regression window)
interfaces.purpose: Strategy adapter interface consumed by upstream clients (e.g. stableYieldAccumulator, stable-staker).
surface: setAsideBufferRecipient() view returns(address) [NEW story-047, address(0) = unset]
criticalSemantics: deposit return creditedPrincipal: market strategy returns the slippage-haircut principal (< nominal); since story-048 the DIRECT ERC4626YieldStrategy (out of scope) returns vault.previewRedeem(sharesReceived) instead of the raw nominal — BOTH concretes now credit <= nominal; callers mirror the ledger, not nominal input.

skimSurplus return value (post-swap underlying actually delivered to recipient, NET of buffer set-aside) can differ substantially from sum of SurplusSkimmed.amount events (pre-swap snapshot, vault-asset terms). Downstream MUST NOT assume equality.

STORY-047: set-aside buffers no longer flow back to each client — they aggregate into one transfer to setAsideBufferRecipient. If any client buffer > 0 while the recipient is unset, skimSurplus REVERTS ('AYieldStrategy: setAsideBufferRecipient not set').
STALE DOC: IYieldStrategy.sol:101 still says 24h waiting / 48h execution for totalWithdrawal; actual constants are 6h / 72h since story-048.
relinquishPrincipal writes down recorded principal WITHOUT moving shares (QA-09 relinquish-to-zero orphan edge ledgered in run-14, still present).
balanceOf is deprecated/ambiguous; use principalOf vs totalBalanceOf explicitly.

interfaces.notes: AYieldStrategy implements: pause()=onlyPauser, unpause()=owner||pauser, pauser() getter

outOfScopeLightNote.status: OUT OF SCOPE (registered), changed by both stories — noted only to clarify the shared parent
outOfScopeLightNote.story-047: identical _distributeBuffer rework + loud guard as the in-scope market strategy (kept in sync by design)
story-048: creditedPrincipal fix: _acquireShares now books vault.previewRedeem(sharesReceived) instead of the raw nominal `amount` — closes over-crediting under entry fees / share round-down; brings the direct strategy in line with the base's 'credit what the position is actually worth' principle the market strategy already followed via its slippage haircut
NEW previewDeposit(assets)/previewRedeem(shares) external views delegating to the vault (NOT added to IYieldStrategy, NOT present on the market strategy)

The base's invariant 'sum(clientBalances) == totalDeposited' is insensitive to HOW the hook prices the credit.
